judge: listening-judge (two independent model passes, keys withheld, per-pass per-row option shuffle)
note: Two independent blind passes over the authored N3 point candidates; the burned rows were replaced by newly authored rows judged in its own packet under the same protocol (.cache/judge/n3-listening/rep). Packets were shuffled INDEPENDENTLY per row per pass, so the key never sat in the same option slot twice and position could not leak the answer. A row ships only when BOTH passes return PASS and both picks are the frozen key. N3 ships authored-only: JLPTSuccess ships listening at N5 only (LICENSE §29), so every N3 row is composed (LICENSE §30).

pass2 UNFIT: Same duplicate pair found per-option; 二番後の電車 and その次の電車 are the same train, so the item cannot be uniquely keyed.

pass2 UNANSWERABLE: Same gap; the man's own wake-up time is not in the transcript, only his instruction to her.
